name: Job Opening: Guard Captain of Revantusk Village

meta.wiki: Job Opening: Guard Captain of Revantusk Village

summary: Revantusk Village needs a new leader for its guard. Applicants must prove themselves against four kinds of Vilebranch and bring an application to Primal Torntusk.

sections.title: A Vacant Post
sections.body: Guard Captain Malkhor has been lost, leaving Revantusk's guard without a captain once more. The notice calls on anyone who wants to lead the guard to complete its work and send an application to Primal Torntusk.

sections.title: Proving Worth
sections.body: To seek the captaincy, defeat Vilebranch Berserkers, Shadow Hunters, Blood Drinkers and Soul Eaters. Then return to Primal Torntusk in Revantusk Village.

faq.q: Why is the position of Guard Captain open?
faq.answer: Guard Captain Malkhor was lost, leaving the captaincy vacant again.

faq.q: Who receives the application once the enemies are slain?
aliases: who do i turn this in to
faq.answer: Bring the application to Primal Torntusk in Revantusk Village.

faq.q: Which enemies must be defeated to qualify?
aliases: who do i kill for guard captain
faq.answer: Applicants must defeat Vilebranch Berserkers, Shadow Hunters, Blood Drinkers and Soul Eaters.
